ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) values with isolated high-intensity (white/beige) clusters at the distal tips and sparse high-contrast circular rings across the mid-section.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark charcoal base; dense three-dimensional beige/white geometric clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; scattered circular white 'halo' mottle patterns throughout the medial ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 40 degrees; vertex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes; right lobe posterior margin exhibits significantly higher amplitude jaggedness and material irregularity compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave curvature along the posterior margins, terminating in tapered, barnacle-encrusted distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular rings (approx. 10-25 pixels in diameter) scattered across both fluke lobes, representing former barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light gray) visible primarily on the central-right lobe surface, appearing as shallow diagonal scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized clusters of live barnacles (Coronula diadema) on the lateral tips; significant ragged-edge deformity and possible material loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of circular 'donut' scars providing a distinct high-frequency point-pattern across the dark ventral pigmentation.
